# AI Build Kit

> AI Build Kit helps people who do not write code build internal tools with a coding agent, an AI assistant that writes software, such as Claude Code or Codex. It installs 19 skills: 6 commands the person types and 13 background skills the commands call.

The six commands guide setup, planning, building and maintenance. The person tries the result and decides how to handle risks. The kit is intended for internal tools where a team can keep working by hand if the tool is unavailable. The kit itself runs no online service and does not store project information. Passing checks do not prove that software is safe or right for the person's purpose, and the kit cannot replace a professional developer or provide legal, medical, financial or security advice. The person is responsible for reading and following the terms of the services their tool uses.

Install one route per project:

- Shared installer: `npx skills add gwpicard/ai-build-kit`. Choose the coding agents and install all the kit's skills for this project. For Codex on a Mac, start each session from the project folder with `python3 .agents/skills/setup-ai-build-kit/scripts/codex-with-github.py`. Then ask the agent to run `setup-ai-build-kit`.
- Claude Code terminal app: `claude plugin marketplace add gwpicard/ai-build-kit`, then `claude plugin install ai-build-kit@ai-build-kit --scope local`. Start Claude Code in the project folder and type `/ai-build-kit:setup-ai-build-kit`.

Commands:

- `/setup-ai-build-kit` prepares a project for work.
- `/shape` turns a request or fault into a ready piece of work.
- `/implement` builds a ready piece and asks for approval before merging by default.
- `/setup-hosting` sets up or checks where and how the tool runs.
- `/maintain` checks the project's records and running tool, and runs maintenance when due.
- `/what-now` reports the project's status and what to do next.

- [AI Build Kit site](https://gwpicard.github.io/ai-build-kit/): the guide to the kit, its workflow, rules, checks, hosting recipes and supported agents.
